description: The input equations belong to every bounded congruence closure computed from them.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.equations_subset_closure.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) :
  E ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure S E
